messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — upstream partner reported marketplace AMIs failing with a kernel/driver mismatch. Need a quick preflight before tomorrow's joint announcement.

maria: which combo are they seeing failures on?

alex: Repro: CUDA=12.2.1 + driver=535.90 + kernel=6.4.3 -> crash during quantized kernel init. Happened on Ampere instances. Partners hit in staging.

partner-nvidia-bot: automated report: test 347 / nv_quant_init failed (OOM-like trace) at nv_compute.c:112. Suggested stable driver: 535.86.05.

chris: Ok — marketplace policy allows an AMI tag with pinned driver/cuda for compatibility. Ops prefers we don't change default image mid-release.

samir: From runtime side we can add a loader fallback: detect kernel ABI at startup and load nv_compat_v2 where available. Adds small init delay but prevents hard crashes.

maria: Important: Dedicated/Private customers can be on their own kernels too. We need a multi-track mitigation (marketplace AMI pin + runtime fallback + partner comms).

alex: Proposed runbook:
1) Ship compat AMI tag: redwood-marketplace:compat-53586 (pins driver 535.86.05 & CUDA 12.2.0).
2) Backport hotfix in quant kernel (eng-ml) to tolerate ABI delta.
3) Runtime loader fallback (eng-runtime) as quick patch.
4) Canary 10% traffic + rollback plan.
5) Coordinate partner announcement + recommended pinned image.

chris: Sounds good. How long for runtime fallback PR @samir?

samir: I'll have a draft PR today (EOD) and tests tomorrow morning. Will include unit + small integration harness.

partner-nvidia-bot: regression history: similar failures seen 2026-02-18 and 2026-03-02. Backport recommendation: nv_quant_abi_compat_v2.patch.

maria: Partnerships will draft partner note asking partners to avoid CUDA 12.2.2 until we verify. I'll include explicit AMI tag and rollback steps.

alex: Eng-sre, can we reserve a canary window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT and prep metrics alerts for error rate + p50/p95 token latency?

chris: I'll add canary runbook entry: `/ops/canary/marketplace-compat-preflight.md` and link the alerts.

maria: Legal — quick ping: any wording constraints for telling partners to pin to compat AMI? @legal

legal: reviewing. high level ok, flagging we should avoid implying broad liability. Share the draft and I'll comment.

alex: Also, small snippet of repro log partners sent (sanitized):
```
[ERR] quant_init failed: kernel-abi-mismatch (expected 0x2a, got 0x28)
stack: nv_compute::init -> nv_quant::load_kernels -> crash
```

chris: Good to have. Ops: add regression test that checks `kernel-abi` header mismatch path.

samir: Will add test in ci/regress/quant_abi_check and wire to nightly.

maria: Timeline proposal: compat AMI now, runtime fallback + hotfix within 48h, canary tomorrow, partner comms after canary green.

alex: Agreed. Assigning owners: AMI/ops = chris, runtime = samir, kernel patch = eng-ml (TBD), comms = maria, legal review = legal.

partner-nvidia-bot: scheduled follow-up check at 2187660050 (automated).

maria: Thanks everyone — will create a follow-up thread with the formal partner note and publish the canary playbook link.

alex: Thanks — sync in 10.
